## <br>Curvas de diseño — `r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "$k_h$"` {.scrollable}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_fig/kh.qmd",
  stem = .composeTargetStem("kh-curves"),
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = list(
    MODELS = c(rigid = "Modelos rígidos", flexible = "Modelos flexibles", ensemble = "Modelos ensemble"),
    CAP = readCaption("fig.kh.ES"),
    CAP.MCE = readCaption("fig.kh.MCE.ES"),
    p.target = "mean"
  ),
  root = root
)
```
